Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Content: The frog can breathe air and water.

Traits.Name: Standing Leap
Traits.Content: The frog's Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Content: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 11).

Actions.Name: Swallow
Actions.Content: The frog swallows a Small or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't Grappled but has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it has Cover|XPHB|Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog. While swallowing the target, the frog can't use Bite, and if the frog dies, the swallowed target is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition. At the end of the frog's next turn, the swallowed target takes 5 (2d4) Acid damage. If that damage doesn't kill it, the frog disgorges it, causing it to exit Prone.

Traits.Name: Swarm
Traits.Content: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.Name: Bites
Actions.Content: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (2d4) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Content: The toad can breathe air and water.

Traits.Name: Standing Leap
Traits.Content: The toad's Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Content: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).

Actions.Name: Swallow
Actions.Content: The toad swallows a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't Grappled but has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it has Cover|XPHB|Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad. In addition, the target takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the end of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time, and it can't use Bite while it has a swallowed target. If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.
